(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, each located on opposite sides of a medial section; an additional adhesive layer wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are configured to be cured to one another, and wherein the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 281, wherein the ring includes a central opening.
